unmerged.name: since Lucia died
unmerged.justification: This refers to an open-ended period beginning after Lucia's death. It is not identical to the specific day-after-funeral or day-after-death time points, and it is distinct from the before/after Asha arrival intervals.

unmerged.name: before Asha came
unmerged.justification: This is a relative period ending at Asha's arrival. It is distinct from the after-Asha period and from the specific funeral/death-related time points.

unmerged.name: after Asha came
unmerged.justification: This is a relative period beginning at Asha's arrival. It is distinct from the before-Asha period and from the specific funeral/death-related time points.

unmerged.name: the day after the funeral
unmerged.justification: This is a specific time point tied to the funeral aftermath and Daniel going through Lucia's desk. It is not explicitly the same as the day after she died.

unmerged.name: the funeral
unmerged.justification: This is the funeral event itself, which is distinct from the day after the funeral and from the broader post-death search period.

unmerged.name: The day after she died
unmerged.justification: This is a specific time point after Lucia's death, but the evidence does not explicitly equate it with the day after the funeral or any of the other relative intervals.
